notes.title: New version 1.36 - level change & bugfixes
notes.content:
Hi!

Update 1.36 just went live!

Several issues had been fixed and the Italy level has been ... for the difficulties easy and medium. Here is an overview of all updates:
[list]
[*]Italy is now easier in easy and medium mode
[*]Level 3 upgrade for cities is now working properly
[*]Industry stops producing resources when maximum capacity has been reached
[*]Resources in industries won't get destroyed when limit for removing resource has been reached
[*]Green dot for requested resource sometimes got stuck
[/list]

Any kind of feedback is appreciated. Don´t hesitate to contact me by dropping me a message via mail or community hub.

A positive review for the game would be very much appreciated!

Enjoy!
Christian

notes.title: UPDATE 1.3 - New world Africa
notes.content:
Hi!

And again the next point of the Mini Countries Roadmap is completed! Just now the next update was uploaded and so the [b]Version 1.3[/b] is now available and playable! [b]This is the biggest update so far![/b]

Here is a list of the new features:
[list]
[*] New world Africa with eight new levels added
[*] Six new resource groups (Coal, Cocoa, Coffee, Copper, Tea and Oil) and 18 new resources in total
[*] Four new music tracks for Africa
[*] Added new trade buildings for new resource groups
[*] New Day and night cycle with influence on production and transport
[*] New industry and storage upgrade possibilities
[*] New "exhausted resource" event
[*] New landscapes (waterfall, desert or disabled tiles within country)
[*] Animals added (elephant, giraffe and lion)
[*] Performance and visuals improved
[*] Showing hint for last item summary
[*] Moving all items with pressed Shift key also works in industries now
[*] Improved LevelScreen & GameScreen UI for better readability
[*] Four new tutorials/hints
[*] Some more small bugfixing
[/list]

Feel free to give me feedback, which I will try to answer as soon as possible. 

Of course I would be very happy about a [b]positive review[/b]! :)

Have fun!
Christian

notes.title: BIG UPDATE 1.1 - Sandbox mode, building automation and three new difficulties
notes.content:
Hey!

I´m glad to release the [b]first mayor update[/b] after the launch on February 12th today!

[h3]Sandbox mode[/h3]
One of the most requested features was a sandbox mode to create a new experience besides the world mode. It´s now possible to setup a custom game setting and play a game occasionally. In case you don't want to make up the settings by yourself you can start a game with random settings to be surprised when starting a new game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37162341/a1dd27cd81193505d895d1912ebec041dacda387.png[/img]

[i]Please note that the sandbox mode is in a preview mode since it´s very hard to test. Feedback is very welcome and the mode will of course be maintained and improved.[/i]

[h3]Automation & difficulties[/h3]

The next feature which has been requested quite often was adding [b]difficulties[/b]. Some players reported the game is very easy at the beginning but very hard lateron. I´ve tried to work on that by adding different difficulties. And it´s very close to the third feature which is [b]automation[/b].

There are now three different difficulties which all have influence on the gameplay:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37162341/43c6148996f7b21b6e7980b098699c242ac2820f.png[/img]

[h3]New tutorial system[/h3]

I also tried to improve the initial tutorial system since it was not intuitive for everyone. The previous system is still included but there now also is a guided tutorial in case you haven't completed any level. The first level in the world mode - in our case Switzerland - will be started with the new system and will guide you through the first steps and the most used mechanics in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37162341/519317434207a3e373e5afb23a1b0c1c9482324c.png[/img]

Here is the full changelog for [b]version 1.1[/b]:
[list]
[*] Three different diffculties with different request times and level behaviour
[*] New sandbox mode to play free games with random or self-made settings
[*] Added more automation (for trade, industry and storage buildings)
[*] New guided tutorial system for getting used to game mechanics
[*] Added cooldown for "Storage full" messages
[*] Some bugfixes
[/list]
Next up will be the [b]online best-score system[/b] which will be available in April. The [b]roadmap [/b]has also been updated on the store page.

Thanks for reading and enjoy!
Cheers, Christian

notes.title: New version 1.04 & updated roadmap
notes.content:
Hey!

First of all a [b]huge thanks[/b] to all the people sending me feedback in the community tab, via Twitter, mail or my Discord!
I really appreciate your help and enthusiasm on the game.

[h2]Updated roadmap & two major features a lot of your requested[/h2]

Before going into detail about the [i][u]current update 1.04[/u][/i], I would like to mention that I´ve decided to update the roadmap for Mini Countries (see Steam store page). But don't worry - it´s an update in a positive way!
Actually I planned to create a new world and then do the mobile/switch port of the game. In the meantime I found out that it´s better to concentrate on the PC version first.

That´s why I wanted to announce [b]two major features[/b] in [b]version 1.1[/b] which will be available soon!

[list]
[*] [b]SANDBOX MODE[/b]: you´ll be able to start a random new game or you can adjust settings like map size, amount of resources, seasons and so on (see preview on [url=https://twitter.com/YheekyGames/status/1363070981129052160]Twitter[/url]).
[*] [b]DIFFICULTIES[/b]: a lot of people told me that the current mode starts too easy and gets too hard. I´m pretty sure you´ll find a better fit after adding the difficulties easy, medium and hard.
[/list]

[i][u]Probably in version 1.2[/u][/i] there will be an [b]online best time mode[/b] and [b]more automation features[/b] as well. Currently the best time is stored locally but you will then be able to compare with other players globally.
Stay tuned!

[h2]Todays update 1.04[/h2]

Today there is another small update. Here are the changes:
[list]
[*] [b]FEATURE[/b]: Monthly summary will not fire if there is a current transport action
[*] [b]FEATURE[/b]: Added indicator for requested resources which can be claimed by open transport
[*] [b]FEATURE[/b]: Wind shader added for improving landscape
[*] [b]BUG[/b]: Removing connection and building returned two connections in total if connection had open transport
[*] [b]BUG[/b]: Sent resources will now be removed if destination building has been deleted during transport
[*] [b]BUG[/b]: Wrong resource combination for producing jewelry displayed in resource combination window
[*] [b]BUG[/b]: Fixed issues on Italy & Spain level
[*] [b]BUG[/b]: Fixed some translation issues
[/list]

I wish you a great weekend and enjoy playing the game! :)

Cheers, Christian
